arxiv-2103-10403.title: Shear-induced spin polarization in heavy-ion collisions
arxiv-2103-10403.creator: Baochi Fu, Shuai Y. F. Liu, Longgang Pang, Huichao Song, Yi Yin
arxiv-2103-10403.description: Abstract We study the spin polarization generated by the hydrodynamic gradients. In addition to the widely studied thermal vorticity effects, we identify an undiscovered contribution from the fluid shear. This shear-induced polarization (SIP) can be viewed as the fluid analog of strain-induced polarization observed in elastic and nematic materials.

arxiv-2112-02280.description: Abstract . We give a stably birational classification for algebraic k k -tori of dimensions 3 3 and 4 4 over a field k k . Kunyavskii [ Kun90 ] proved that there exist 15 15 not stably k k -rational cases among 73 73 cases of algebraic k k -tori of dimension 3 3 .

arxiv-2502-20377.title: PhantomWiki: On-Demand Datasets for Reasoning and Retrieval Evaluation
arxiv-2502-20377.creator: Albert Gong, Kamilė Stankevičiūtė, Chao Wan, Anmol Kabra, Raphael Thesmar, Johann Lee, Julius Klenke, Carla P. Gomes, Kilian Q. Weinberger
arxiv-2502-20377.description: Abstract High-quality benchmarks are essential for evaluating reasoning and retrieval capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, curating datasets for this purpose is not a permanent solution as they are prone to data leakage and inflated performance results. To address these challenges, we propose PhantomWiki : a pipeline to generate unique, factually consistent document corpora with diverse question-answer pairs.

arxiv-2503-17495.title: Investigation of FWER and power for methodological changes introduced in the bdots R package
arxiv-2503-17495.creator: Collin Nolte
arxiv-2503-17495.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Collin Nolte. In 2025, we identified a methodological issue in the bootstrapped differences of times series (BDOTS) first introduced in 2017 resulting in a significant inflation of the family-wise error rate. The goal of the present manuscript is threefold: to identify the problem in the original methodology, to present two alternative solutions, and to compare estimates of the FWER and power of each of the considered methods across a variety of experimental conditions.

arxiv-2509-21870.title: Enhancing Low-Rank Adaptation with Structured Nonlinear Transformations * Equal Contribution † Corresponding Author
arxiv-2509-21870.creator: Guanzhi Deng 1,2∗ , Mingyang Liu 1,2∗ , Dapeng Wu 1 , Yinqiao Li 1,2† , Linqi Song 1,2†
arxiv-2509-21870.description: Abstract Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely adopted parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models. However, its linear nature limits expressiveness. We propose LoRAN, a non-linear extension of LoRA that applies lightweight transformations to the low-rank updates. We further introduce Sinter, a sine-based activation that adds structured perturbations without increasing parameter count.

arxiv-2512-20998.title: Universality and Criticality in Mass-less Scalar Field Collapse
arxiv-2512-20998.creator: Koushiki, Rituparno Goswami, Pankaj S. Joshi
arxiv-2512-20998.description: Abstract In this paper, we observe the collapse of a mass-less scalar field covariantly. We show that the strengths of the collapsing and dispersing modes of this scalar field will decide whether the collapse will end up in a black-hole or disperse.

pmc-11296772.title: NVTG-06 MELANOMA BRAIN METASTASES BENEFIT FROM HIGH PRKCZ LEVELS
pmc-11296772.creator: Lisa Schöne, Matthias Meinhardt, Marie-Christin Mehnert, Stefan Beissert, Friedegund Meier, Dana Westphal
pmc-11296772.description: Despite current therapies being proven effective against metastasized melanoma, durable responses against melanoma brain metastases remain pending. The main reasons are brain-specific resistance mechanisms, which motivate investigations into the underlying differences between intracranial and extracranial metastases. While the mutational status is mainly unaltered, epigenetic regulation is diverging.

pmc-11652549.title: Impact of Extreme Heat on Cardiovascular Health in Kuwait: Present and Future Projections
pmc-11652549.creator: Yazan Alwadi, Ali Al-Hemoud, Haitham Khraishah, Fahd Al-Mulla, Petros Koutrakis, Hamad Ali, Barrak Alahmad
pmc-11652549.description: BackgroundThe Middle East, especially Kuwait, is experiencing rapidly rising temperatures due to climate change. Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) are the leading cause of mortality in the country, and extreme heat is expected to exacerbate hospitalizations for cardiovascular diseases. There is limited data quantifying the historical and future impacts of heat on hospitalizations for cardiovascular diseases in Kuwait.

pmc-11678754.title: Investigation of Shear Behavior in High-Strength Bolt Connectors for Steel–Concrete Composite Beams
pmc-11678754.creator: Wei Li, Jie Wang, Xiaobo Xing, Huining Liu, Jin Di, Xianchao Sun, Leibo Li, Hongwei Li, Fengjiang Qin, Dario De Domenico
pmc-11678754.description: High-strength bolt connectors, known for their robust strength and ease of disassembly, are suitable not only for the construction of new steel–concrete composite beams but also for reinforcing existing composite or steel beams. Static push-out tests were performed on nine specimens to examine their shear behavior.

pmc-11861233.title: A Machine Learning Model for Predicting Major Depressive Disorder Using Diffusion-Tensor Imaging Data
pmc-11861233.creator: J H Lee, D-K Lee
pmc-11861233.description: IntroductionMajor Depressive Disorder (MDD) stands as a prevalent psychiatric condition within the general population. Despite extensive research efforts, the identification of definitive diagnostic biomarkers for depressive disorders remains elusive. Currently, machine learning methods are gaining prominence in the diagnosis of medical illnesses.

pmc-12429627.title: High Radial Artery Puncture Reduces CRPS Risk for Women: A Retrospective Case Series
pmc-12429627.creator: Takehiro Hashikata, Masahiko Shibuya, Yoshiaki Shintani, Koichi Miyazaki, Yuji Okuno, Mohammad Reza Movahed
pmc-12429627.description: Background/Objectives: Radial artery access (RAA) is widely used for catheter-based procedures due to its safety and convenience, but complex regional pain syndrome (CRPS) remains a rare, underrecognized complication—particularly in women. CRPS manifests as prolonged, severe pain and autonomic symptoms, often associated with nerve irritation near the carpal tunnel.

pmc-12608981.title: Effects of Tetrabasic Zinc Chloride as Alternative to High Doses of Zinc Oxide on Growth Performance, Nutrient Digestibility, Intestinal Morphology, Immune Function, and Gut Microbiota in Weaned Piglets
pmc-12608981.creator: Shuyu Peng, Jingzi Fang, Nan Zhang, Yi Chen, Yongxi Ma, Chunlin Wang, Beob Gyun Kim
pmc-12608981.description: Simple SummaryZinc, an essential trace element for piglets, has a crucial role in promoting their growth and development, as well as maintaining vital physiological functions. Currently, the prevalent zinc source additives, such as zinc oxide and zinc sulfate, typically exhibit limitations due to their low bioavailability.

pmc-12744362.title: Evaluating Custom and Transfer Learning Convolutional Neural Networks for Pneumonia Classification Under Data Scarcity and Low-Compute Conditions for Under-Resourced Environments
pmc-12744362.creator: Andy L Chen, Eric Cheek, Morteza Samradi
pmc-12744362.description: Pneumonia is an infectious disease that causes many deaths across the world. By accurately and efficiently recognizing pneumonia from images using machine learning, we can facilitate faster treatment. Yet, in under-resourced environments, there is often a lack of training data, high-quality images for training, as well as a lack of high computing power.

pmc-13335859.title: Quantum Photothermal Self‐Monitoring Fiber Probes for In Vivo Photothermal Therapy
pmc-13335859.creator: Wanjun Li, Ruixiao Hu, Jie Mao, Jin Wo, Yunsong Zhang, Liang Chen, Ying Liu, Zhibo Li, Yongxin Lin, Minghui Du, Yaofei Chen, Libing Zhou, Tuan Guo
pmc-13335859.description: The photothermal properties of diamond nitrogen‐vacancy (NV) centers enable simultaneous fluorescence emission and localized heating, yet conventional free‐space quantum systems suffer from limited photothermal efficiency (typically<4°C/mW) and inadequate microwave integration (large in size). We developed a miniaturized quantum photothermal fiber probe utilizing a novel metal/polymer/glass composite optoelectronic fiber that simultaneously guides both lightwave and microwave radiation (at GHz).

pmc-13408533.title: The Transepithelial Transport and Transport Pathways of Free and Bound Nε-Carboxymethyllysine Using a Caco-2 Cell Monolayer Model
pmc-13408533.creator: Xiaojin Yuan, Chenxi Nie, Ruohan Zhai, Aobai Tu, Xinyu Cao, Li Zhang, Juxiu Li
pmc-13408533.description: As a typical marker of dietary advanced glycation end products (AGEs), Nε-carboxymethyllysine (CML) exists in both free and protein-bound forms in foods, exhibiting distinct intestinal transport behaviors. This study aimed to characterize the transepithelial transport, intracellular accumulation and transport pathways of free CML (FC) and protein-bound CML (BC, BSA-CML) using Caco-2 cell monolayers.

pmc-13595460.title: MET Expression in Upper Gastrointestinal Adenocarcinoma: Prevalence, Prognostic Impact, and Implications for Anti‐MET Antibody‐Drug Conjugate Therapy
pmc-13595460.creator: Tillmann Bedau, Thomas Zander, Hans Anton Schlößer, Hakan Alakus, Onur Mustafov, Reinhard Büttner, Christiane Bruns, Alexander Quaas
pmc-13595460.description: MET is an actionable receptor tyrosine kinase, and MET‐directed antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) have recently entered clinical practice with FDA approval in non‐small cell lung cancer and are now being evaluated across gastrointestinal malignancies, with patient selection based on MET immunohistochemistry (IHC) 3+ membranous staining at varying percentage thresholds.
